thread:
Sofia (sales): Orbit pilot kickoff tomorrow AM. Dry run surfaced a few items: streaming drops, tool-call schema mismatch, and IdP refresh rejects. Can presales/eng triage?
Dmitri (presales): Logs show SSE closes after ~30s during big responses. Also tool `func_call` payloads come back snake_case; their runtime expects camelCase. IdP error: `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Aria (eng): SSE keepalive default is 25s. Recommend `client.setHeartbeat(10000)` for now. Will add env `SDK_KEEPALIVE_MS=10000` to sample.
Sofia (sales): Can we push a sample patch before tomorrow?
Aria (eng): Yes 10-min patch. Also change sample app to use ephemeral port by default to avoid the `EADDRINUSE` we hit.
Dmitri (presales): For schema mismatch, can we upstream a compatibility helper?
Aria (eng): We'll add `utils.normalizeKeys(resp, 'camelCase')` to examples and a tiny snippet in the README. Low-risk.
Sofia (sales): IdP issue details?
Dmitri (presales): Their IdP requires signed assertions for refresh. Our connector attempted client_credentials and IdP returned `missing_assertion`.
Aria (eng): Two options: 1) Enable our session-exchange endpoint (accepts signed assertions) 1-2 days turnaround after legal AUP signed, JIRA `orbit-session-exchange`; or 2) issue a short-lived delegated key for connector (security prefers timeboxed keys).
Sofia (sales): I'll loop legal. Which is faster?
Aria (eng): Delegated key fastest but possibly blocked by security; session-exchange needs legal signoff but is preferred.
ops-bot: deploy failed: `orbit-sample` -> EADDRINUSE:8080
Aria (eng): I'll push PR with heartbeat, normalize util, and port fix. Draft `pr/2002-orbit-pilot-fixes`.
Dmitri (presales): Pricing Q: does streaming cost more? What about tool calls?
Aria (eng): Billing: streaming and non-streaming both billed per emitted token. Tool/function calls add a small per-call metadata fee. For pilots we can cap spend and enable token-level telemetry.
Sofia (sales): Action items: 1) I create JIRA and loop legal; 2) Aria pushes PR and pings when merged; 3) Dmitri updates pilot runbook with heartbeat + normalize snippet + SSO options; 4) infra retries deploy.
Aria (eng): Will standby during the run and roll back sample image if issues.
Sofia (sales): Thanks all :thumbsup: Will update after JIRA and PR merge.
